firstPlayerRule: Randomly determine who gets the starting player token. That player gets 2 food; each other player gets 3 food.
clarifications: In each work phase, players place people beginning with the starting player and continuing clockwise.
The starting player does not change automatically. A player becomes starting player by using the “Meeting Place” action space; if no one uses it, the token stays put.
In the solo game you start with 0 food.
